source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកដី" [Peanut/groundnut cultivation], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text:
This ECOSORN-project farmer leaflet covers peanut/groundnut (សណ្តែកដី, Arachis hypogaea) as a compact 2-page extension sheet, consistent with the format of the other ECOSORN leaflets in this batch (soybean Source A). Per the batch's standing bean-specific guidance, peanut is kept as its own separate product rather than folded into a generic "bean" category, since Cambodian usage and prior project convention both treat it as distinct.

The leaflet's content follows the same short-form structure as the ECOSORN soybean leaflet: brief land preparation guidance, note on selecting clean/uniform seed, planting/spacing guidance, a staged fertilizer-timing schedule tied to crop growth, and harvest-timing guidance (watching for the characteristic peanut sign of maturity — since pods develop underground on "pegs," Cambodian extension material typically advises checking a sample of dug plants for pod fill and shell hardening/internal seed-coat color change rather than relying on above-ground foliage color alone, though the leaflet's own specific wording on this point was brief and is summarized rather than quoted directly here). As with the batch's other short leaflets, detailed numeric spacing/rate values beyond what could be confidently read from the source images are not reproduced.
